motivation: Post hoc control addition after observing the original MA-1164 fresh data. Use distinct new splits; do not pool with earlier fresh evidence.
hypothesis: Mirror with m learned scalars outperforms a conventional trained MLP with a comparable m independent scalars, at actual inference bytes and valid held-out classification accuracy. Also compare full original MLP saved FP16.
data: sklearn load_digits 1797 images, 64 features, ten classes. Stratified 20% test, remaining 20% dev, 80% train. Same source corpus reused in different world partitions; not independent natural domains.
optimizer: AdamW weight_decay0, LR dev-selected separately for each native hidden width; 900 updates; minibatch128, deterministic RNG; no test tuning.
teacher: Trained full-width16 FP64 from same train partition, then frozen and mechanically fitted by teacher WEIGHTS only, no labels or logits during compilation. Initialization seed and LR also frozen. Pretraining cost must be disclosed.
mirror_fit: MA-1164 source/run.py fit_teacher_weights on frozen teacher, top-m teacher-informed coords paid in bytes; L-BFGS weight-space only; no new K/R search.
evaluation: All new worlds and two seeds, last sample predictions on held-out 20% split; accuracy NLL; MAC proxy, measured batch64 CPU eager FP64 forward median, actual torch.save inference bytes and full program source code size; all rows retained.
decision: Mirror-specific benefit only if >=1 percentage point above nearest-parameter standard native MLP and same-m plain in >=2/3 worlds AND actually smaller total inference bytes than full FP16 native model; else FAIL. Multiple seeds are paired within each world; report uncertainty limitation.
compute_environment: AMD EPYC 9V74 CPU virtual environment PyTorch2.10+cpu float64 one thread; no GPU. FP16 is serialized storage only, replay cast to float64.
stop_rule: Fixed 900 updates and all specified worlds; no early stopping. If a condition fails record all partial rows and mark INCOMPLETE rather than claiming a full comparison.
frozen_but_conditional: Exact selected native learning rates become immutable after development and before first new evaluation world; source/protocol hashes written then.
